recommended_first_slice.rule: Inherited base first; channel objects in order; exact group identity appends Channel index+1 and pipe. No IsUnused or DMX filter. Old class has no logic collection.

findings.channel_unused: Group.IsUnused AND DMXPatchInfo == 0; not merely GroupAddress == 255
findings.action: Scene index is zero-based in text. Skip IsUnused. Advanced mode matches recall group to queried level group regardless of selector; basic mode matches exact recall level object. Append <li />Advanced Trigger Scene N or <li />Trigger Scene N.
findings.scene_unused: No included on channel AND no included off channel across collection; levels and output-group usage are not tested.
findings.group_loader: GroupAddress string attribute at +0x104; split on spaces; index channel directly; missing element default 255; FindGroupByAddress with add=true in primary application
findings.other: Inherited TGOC first, then exact CBusDisableGroupAddress identity appends C-Bus Disable Group|, then DMXCBusSwitchAddress identity appends DMX Switch|
findings.input: Channel-major then scene-major; queried group matches output channel; scene must be used and channel on/off included; recall group nonnull and nonunused yields Scene index+1| else Scene index+1 (Unused)|
findings.l1: Separate 1.9.03..9 class/agent adds LogicGroupAddress and packed LogicAttributes; no DIN loader reuse
findings.body: Base DocumentHTML directly then Bytecraft class guard. Optional lock/DMX/restore columns; scene zero used for restore ramp and channel levels. Scene table literal deliberately lacks closing > in <table border="1".
findings.preset_record: 32 byte space-separated values per PresetRecNN: mode index0, Trigger group index1, selector Address index2, link group index3, on mask (byte4<<8)+byte5, on levels byte6+channel, off mask (byte18<<8)+byte19, off levels byte20+channel. Mask bit channel supplies Boolean setter input. Ramp nibbles use Int4BitArrayElementWithDefault indices9 and37. Setter normalization still needs careful bounded admission.
findings.selector_identity: Loader helper calls FindLevelByAddress with add=true, not FindLevelByValue. Basic action exact object identity; advanced same group object only. All qualifying scenes append in ascending index order; no deduplication or first-match break.
findings.boolean_normalization_hazard: Loader passes EDX=(1<<channel)&mask directly, while SetPresetOnChannel and SetPresetOffChannel consume DL (one byte). Do not replace with Python bool(mask & bit) without recovering Variant Boolean normalization. Mode setter similarly consumes low byte.

limits: Assessment only. No runtime implementation or native page comparison.
Malformed, partial arrays and native auto-created group objects need explicit adapter policy; absent PP must not silently assert saved defaults.
Action and body slices require full PresetRec00..32 decoding and setter normalization; these prerequisites are not fully recovered here.
DIMPR12A specification is a different DIN-style schema, not evidence for Bytecraft DIMPR12 loader equivalence.
Full scene/action adapter remains blocked on exact byte Boolean/Variant normalization, constructor scene count and record default semantics. Output-only consumer does not consume scenes.
